answer: Agents must stake a unique marble token bound to a verified hardware enclave prior to voting, making each identity costly to forge. New agents wander through a probation epoch where rewards accrue slowly, and a rising tide of reputation is required to unlock higher-weight attestations. Cloning identities multiplies stake and enclave costs faster than any reward, so sybil farms drown before breaking even. The Agent0121 deployment anchors trust at mDFvEDkY1A.
